productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: 你好 (ni hao) - hello! Learn some of the most commonly used words in Mandarin, the most spoken language in the world! Did you know that 1.5 billion people live in China, the country in Asia where Mandarin comes from? That’s a lot of people! Interested in learning this fascinating language? Here’s a great place to start! Join Sophie and Elim in this fun and interactive card as they teach you 100 commonly-used words in Mandarin… from 你好 nǐ hǎo to 再见 zàijiàn! Tracks included: Introduction to Mandarin The Basics - Part 1 你好 [ní hǎo] / Hello 再见 [zàijiàn] / Goodbye 谢谢 [xièxiè] / Thank You 不客气 [bù kèqì] / You're Welcome 不好意思 [bù hǎo yìsi] / Excuse Me The Basics - Practice 1 How do you say “hello” in Mandarin? How do you say “goodbye” in Mandarin? How do you say “thank you” in Mandarin? How do you say “you’re welcome” in Mandarin? Do you remember how to say “excuse me” in Mandarin? End Practice 1 请 [qǐng] / Please 上 [shàng] / Up 下 [xià] / Down 早上好 [zǎoshang hǎo] / Good Morning 晚安 [wǎn ān] / Good Night The Basics - Practice 2 What’s the word for “please” in Mandarin? What is the word for “up” in Mandarin? How do you say “down” in Mandarin? How do you say “good morning” in Mandarin? How do you say “good night” in Mandarin? End Practice 2 开心 [kāi xīn] / Happy 伤心 [shāng xīn] / Sad 生气 [shēng qì] / Angry 害怕 [hài pà] / Scared 无聊 [wú liáo] / Bored Feelings - Practice 1 How do you say “happy” in Mandarin? How do you say “sad” in Mandarin? How do you say “angry” in Mandarin? How do you say “scared” in Mandarin? How do you say “scared” in Mandarin? End Practice 1 惊讶 [jīng yà] / Surprised 累 [lèi] / Tired 困惑 [kùn huò] / Confused 平静 [píng jìng] / Calm 兴奋 [xīng fèn] / Excited Feelings - Practice 2 How do you say “surprised” in Mandarin? How do you say “tired” in Mandarin? How do you say “confused” in Mandarin? How do you say “calm” in Mandarin? How do you say “excited” in Mandarin? End Practice 2 妈妈 [māmā] Mom 爸爸 [bàba] / Dad 姐姐 [jiějie] / Older Sister 妹妹 [mèimei] / Younger Sister 哥哥 [gēgē] / Older Brother Feelings - Practice 1 How do you say “mom” in Mandarin? How do you say “dad” in Mandarin? How do you say “older sister” in Mandarin? How do you say “younger sister” in Mandarin? What’s the word in Mandarin for “older brother”? End Practice 1 弟弟 [dìdì] / Younger Brother 外婆 [wài pó] / Grandmother - Your mother’s mother! 奶奶 [nai nai] / Grandmother - Your father’s mother!  外公 [wài gōng] / Grandfather - Your mother’s father! 爷爷 [ye ye] / Grandfather - Your father’s father! What would you call your “grandfather,” your father’s father, in Mandarin? End Practice 2 宠物 [chǒngwù] Pet 猫 [māo] / Cat 狗 [gǒu] / Dog 鱼 [yú] / Fish 鸟 [niǎo] / Bird Pets - Practice 1 How do you say “pet” in Mandarin? How do you say “cat” in Mandarin? seo.title: My First 100 Words in Mandarin
seo.description: Yoto Says: 你好 (ni hao) - hello! Learn some of the most commonly used words in Mandarin, the most spoken language in the world! Did you know that 1.5 billion people live in China, the country in Asia where Mandarin comes from? That’s a lot of people! Interested in learning this fascinating language? Here’s a great place to start! Join Sophie and Elim in this fun and interactive card as they teach you 100 commonly-used words in Mandarin… from 你好 nǐ hǎo to 再见 zàijiàn! Tracks included: Introduction to Mandarin, The Basics - Part 1, 你好 [ní hǎo] / Hello, 再见 [zàijiàn] / Goodbye, 谢谢 [xièxiè] / Thank You and more.
